    90	async function applyAndroidNavigationBarTheme() {
    91	  if (Platform.OS !== "android") return;
    92	
    93	  try {
    94	    StatusBar.setHidden(false);
    95	    StatusBar.setBarStyle(androidStatusBarStyle, true);
    96	  } catch {}
    97	
    98	  try {
    99	    await NavigationBar.setVisibilityAsync("visible");
   100	  } catch {}
   101	
   102	  try {
   103	    await NavigationBar.setButtonStyleAsync(androidNavigationBarButtonStyle);
   104	  } catch {}
   105	}

   107	function AndroidNavigationBarTint({ dimStatusBar = false, pathname }) {
   108	  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
   109	
   110	  useEffect(() => {
   111	    if (Platform.OS !== "android") return undefined;
   112	
   113	    const applyTheme = () => applyAndroidNavigationBarTheme();
   114	
   115	    applyTheme();
   116	    const restoreTimer = setTimeout(applyTheme, 250);
   117	    const finalRestoreTimer = setTimeout(applyTheme, 1000);
   118	    const appStateSubscription = AppState.addEventListener("change", (state) => {
   119	      if (state === "active") {
   120	        applyTheme();
   121	      }
   122	    });
   123	    let visibilitySubscription;
   124	
   125	    try {
   126	      visibilitySubscription = NavigationBar.addVisibilityListener(
   127	        applyTheme,
   128	      );
   129	    } catch {}
   130	
   131	    return () => {
   132	      clearTimeout(restoreTimer);
   133	      clearTimeout(finalRestoreTimer);
   134	      appStateSubscription.remove();
   135	      visibilitySubscription?.remove();
   136	    };
   137	  }, [dimStatusBar, pathname]);
   138	
   139	  if (Platform.OS !== "android" || insets.bottom <= 0) {
   140	    return null;
   141	  }
   142	
   143	  return (
   144	    <View
   145	      pointerEvents="none"
   146	      style={{
   147	        position: "absolute",
   148	        left: 0,
   149	        right: 0,
   150	        bottom: 0,
   151	        height: insets.bottom,
   152	        borderTopWidth: androidNavigationBarHairlineWidth,
   153	        borderTopColor: androidNavigationBarHairlineColor,
   154	        backgroundColor: androidNavigationBarColor,
   155	        zIndex: 1000001,
   156	        elevation: 1000001,
   157	      }}
   158	    />
   159	  );
   160	}

   219	function StartupSplashArtwork({ style = null }) {
   220	  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
   221	  const iconScale = useRef(
   222	    new Animated.Value(startupSplashIconInitialScale),
   223	  ).current;
   224	  const iconSpin = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   225	  const iconMaskScale = useRef(
   226	    new Animated.Value(startupSplashIconMaskMaxScale),
   227	  ).current;
   228	  const iconSize = Math.min(
   229	    startupSplashIconMaxSize,
   230	    Math.max(startupSplashIconMinSize, width * 0.38),
   231	  );
   232	  const iconOuterRadius = iconSize * startupSplashIconOuterRadiusRatio;
   233	  const iconInnerInset = iconSize * startupSplashIconInnerInsetRatio;
   234	  const iconInnerSize = iconSize * startupSplashIconInnerSizeRatio;
   235	  const iconInnerRadius = iconInnerSize * startupSplashIconInnerRadiusRatio;
   236	  const iconBorderMaskSize = iconSize * startupSplashIconBorderMaskSizeRatio;
   237	  const iconBorderMaskOffset = (iconSize - iconBorderMaskSize) / 2;
   238	  const iconBorderMaskRadius =
   239	    iconBorderMaskSize * startupSplashIconOuterRadiusRatio;
   240	  const iconBorderMaskRotation = iconSpin.interpolate({
   241	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   242	    outputRange: ["0deg", "360deg"],
   243	  });
   244	
   245	  useEffect(() => {
   246	    const scaleAnimation = Animated.sequence([
   247	      Animated.timing(iconScale, {
   248	        toValue: startupSplashIconPeakScale,
   249	        duration: startupSplashIconEnlargeDuration,
   250	        easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic),
   251	        useNativeDriver: true,
   252	      }),
   253	      Animated.spring(iconScale, {
   254	        toValue: 1,
   255	        friction: 5,
   256	        tension: 90,
   257	        useNativeDriver: true,
   258	      }),
   259	    ]);
   260	    const spinAnimation = Animated.loop(
   261	      Animated.timing(iconSpin, {
   262	        toValue: 1,
   263	        duration: startupSplashIconSpinDuration,
   264	        easing: Easing.linear,
   265	        useNativeDriver: true,
   266	      }),
   267	    );
   268	    const maskPulseAnimation = Animated.loop(
   269	      Animated.sequence([
   270	        Animated.timing(iconMaskScale, {
   271	          toValue: startupSplashIconMaskMinScale,
   272	          duration: startupSplashIconMaskPulseDuration,
   273	          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad),
   274	          useNativeDriver: true,
   275	        }),
   276	        Animated.timing(iconMaskScale, {
   277	          toValue: startupSplashIconMaskMaxScale,
   278	          duration: startupSplashIconMaskPulseDuration,
   279	          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad),
   280	          useNativeDriver: true,
   281	        }),
   282	      ]),
   283	    );
   284	
   285	    scaleAnimation.start();
   286	    spinAnimation.start();
   287	    maskPulseAnimation.start();
   288	
   289	    return () => {
   290	      scaleAnimation.stop();
   291	      spinAnimation.stop();
   292	      maskPulseAnimation.stop();
   293	      iconScale.stopAnimation();
   294	      iconSpin.stopAnimation();
   295	      iconMaskScale.stopAnimation();
   296	    };
   297	  }, [iconMaskScale, iconScale, iconSpin]);
   298	
   299	  return (
   300	    <View
   301	      pointerEvents="none"
   302	      style={[
   303	        {
   304	          flex: 1,
   305	        },
   306	        style,
   307	      ]}
   308	    >
   309	      <StartupOrangeBackground
   310	        style={{
   311	          position: "absolute",
   312	          top: 0,
   313	          right: 0,
   314	          bottom: 0,
   315	          left: 0,
   316	        }}
   317	      />
   318	      <View
   319	        style={{
   320	          position: "absolute",
   321	          top: 0,
   322	          right: 0,
   323	          bottom: 0,
   324	          left: 0,
   325	          alignItems: "center",
   326	          justifyContent: "center",
   327	        }}
   328	      >
   329	        <Animated.View
   330	          style={{
   331	            height: iconSize,
   332	            transform: [{ scale: iconScale }],
   333	            width: iconSize,
   334	          }}
   335	        >
   336	          <Animated.View
   337	            pointerEvents="none"
   338	            style={{
   339	              position: "absolute",
   340	              top: iconBorderMaskOffset,
   341	              left: iconBorderMaskOffset,
   342	              height: iconBorderMaskSize,
   343	              width: iconBorderMaskSize,
   344	              backgroundColor: startupSplashIconBorderMaskCreamColor,
   345	              borderRadius: iconBorderMaskRadius,
   346	              transform: [
   347	                { rotate: iconBorderMaskRotation },
   348	                { scale: iconMaskScale },
   349	              ],
   350	            }}
   351	          />
   352	          <Image
   353	            resizeMode="stretch"
   354	            source={startupSplashIconImage}
   355	            style={{
   356	              height: iconSize,
   357	              width: iconSize,
   358	            }}
   359	          />
   360	          <View
   361	            pointerEvents="none"
   362	            style={{
   363	              position: "absolute",
   364	              top: 0,
   365	              right: 0,
   366	              bottom: 0,
   367	              left: 0,
   368	              borderRadius: iconOuterRadius,
   369	              overflow: "hidden",
   370	            }}
   371	          >
   372	            <Animated.View
   373	              style={{
   374	                position: "absolute",
   375	                top: iconBorderMaskOffset,
   376	                left: iconBorderMaskOffset,
   377	                height: iconBorderMaskSize,
   378	                width: iconBorderMaskSize,
   379	                backgroundColor: startupSplashIconBorderMaskColor,
   380	                borderRadius: iconBorderMaskRadius,
   381	                transform: [
   382	                  { rotate: iconBorderMaskRotation },
   383	                  { scale: iconMaskScale },
   384	                ],
   385	              }}
   386	            />
   387	          </View>
   388	          <View
   389	            pointerEvents="none"
   390	            style={{
   391	              position: "absolute",
   392	              top: iconInnerInset,
   393	              left: iconInnerInset,
   394	              height: iconInnerSize,
   395	              width: iconInnerSize,
   396	              borderRadius: iconInnerRadius,
   397	              overflow: "hidden",
   398	            }}
   399	          >
   400	            <Image
   401	              resizeMode="stretch"
   402	              source={startupSplashIconImage}
   403	              style={{
   404	                position: "absolute",
   405	                top: -iconInnerInset,
   406	                left: -iconInnerInset,
   407	                height: iconSize,
   408	                width: iconSize,
   409	              }}
   410	            />
   411	          </View>
   412	        </Animated.View>
   413	      </View>
   414	    </View>
   415	  );
   416	}

   497	function RootLayoutContent({ headerScrollY, isStartupSplashReady }) {
   498	  const pathname = usePathname();
   499	  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
   500	  const [isStartupTutorialVisible, setIsStartupTutorialVisible] =
   501	    useState(true);
   502	  const [isStartupSplashDismissed, setIsStartupSplashDismissed] =
   503	    useState(false);
   504	  const startupTransitionProgress = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   505	  const backgroundHeroState = useBackgroundHeroState();
   506	  const {
   507	    cartOverlayActionRequest,
   508	    isQuestionOverlayVisible,
   509	    isShopOverlayVisible,
   510	  } = useShopCart();
   511	  const screenSwipe = useHeaderSwipe();
   512	  const topSafeInset = getTopSafeInset(insets);
   513	
   514	  const showPersistentHeader = pathname !== "/shop";
   515	
   516	  const useOverlayHeader =
   517	    pathname === "/" ||
   518	    pathname === "/products" ||
   519	    pathname === "/aboutus" ||
   520	    pathname === "/contact";
   521	
   522	  const shouldProtectBackgroundHero =
   523	    useOverlayHeader &&
   524	    Boolean(screenSwipe?.isActive || backgroundHeroState?.isFrozen);
   525	  const isShopQuestionOverlayVisible =
   526	    pathname === "/shop" && isQuestionOverlayVisible;
   527	  const backgroundHeroLayerDepth = shouldProtectBackgroundHero ? 100 : 0;
   528	  const screenFadeTopOffset = pathname === "/shop"
   529	    ? 120 + topSafeInset
   530	    : 84 + topSafeInset;
   531	  const shouldShowScreenFade =
   532	    !(pathname === "/shop" && isShopOverlayVisible) &&
   533	    !isShopQuestionOverlayVisible;
   534	  const shouldShowCartOpeningDim =
   535	    cartOverlayActionRequest.pending && pathname !== "/shop";
   536	  const shouldDimAndroidStatusBar =
   537	    Platform.OS === "android" &&
   538	    ((pathname === "/shop" && isShopOverlayVisible) ||
   539	      isShopQuestionOverlayVisible);
   540	  const shouldShowStartupTutorial =
   541	    isStartupTutorialVisible && isStartupSplashReady;
   542	  const startupSplashOpacity = startupTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   543	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   544	    outputRange: [1, 0],
   545	  });
   546	  const handleStartupTutorialClose = useCallback(() => {
   547	    setIsStartupTutorialVisible(false);
   548	  }, []);
   549	
   550	  useEffect(() => {
   551	    if (!isStartupSplashReady || isStartupSplashDismissed) return undefined;
   552	
   553	    Animated.timing(startupTransitionProgress, {
   554	      toValue: 1,
   555	      duration: startupSplashFadeDuration,
   556	      easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic),
   557	      useNativeDriver: true,
   558	    }).start(({ finished }) => {
   559	      if (finished) {
   560	        setIsStartupSplashDismissed(true);
   561	      }
   562	    });
   563	
   564	    return () => {
   565	      startupTransitionProgress.stopAnimation();
   566	    };
   567	  }, [
   568	    isStartupSplashDismissed,
   569	    isStartupSplashReady,
   570	    startupTransitionProgress,
   571	  ]);
   572	
   573	  return (
   574	    <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: "#FFFCF2" }}>
   575	      {showPersistentHeader && useOverlayHeader ? (
   576	        <View
   577	          pointerEvents="none"
   578	          style={{
   579	            position: "absolute",
   580	            top: 0,
   581	            left: 0,
   582	            right: 0,
   583	            zIndex: backgroundHeroLayerDepth,
   584	            elevation: backgroundHeroLayerDepth,
   585	          }}
   586	        >
   587	          <AppHeader scrollY={headerScrollY} showOnlyHero />
   588	        </View>
   589	      ) : null}
   590	
   591	      <MainScreenPushFrame>
   592	        <Stack
   593	          screenOptions={{
   594	            headerShown: false,
   595	            animation: "none",
   596	            contentStyle: {
   597	              backgroundColor: useOverlayHeader
   598	                ? "transparent"
   599	                : "#FFFCF2",
   600	            },
   601	          }}
   602	        />
   603	      </MainScreenPushFrame>
   604	
   605	      {shouldShowScreenFade ? (
   606	        <ScreenFade
   607	          showTopFade={!useOverlayHeader}
   608	          topOffset={screenFadeTopOffset}
   609	        />
   610	      ) : null}
   611	
   612	      {showPersistentHeader && useOverlayHeader ? (
   613	        <View
   614	          pointerEvents="box-none"
   615	          style={{
   616	            position: "absolute",
   617	            top: 0,
   618	            left: 0,
   619	            right: 0,
   620	            zIndex: 1000000,
   621	            elevation: 1000000,
   622	          }}
   623	        >
   624	          <AppHeader
   625	            dimHeaderExceptShopButton={isShopQuestionOverlayVisible}
   626	            scrollY={headerScrollY}
   627	            showHero={false}
   628	          />
   629	        </View>
   630	      ) : null}
   631	
   632	      {showPersistentHeader && !useOverlayHeader ? (
   633	        <AppHeader
   634	          dimHeaderExceptShopButton={isShopQuestionOverlayVisible}
   635	          scrollY={headerScrollY}
   636	        />
   637	      ) : null}
   638	
   639	      {shouldShowCartOpeningDim ? (
   640	        <View
   641	          pointerEvents="none"
   642	          style={{
   643	            position: "absolute",
   644	            top: 0,
   645	            right: 0,
   646	            bottom: 0,
   647	            left: 0,
   648	            backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
   649	            zIndex: 1000001,
   650	            elevation: 1000001,
   651	          }}
   652	        />
   653	      ) : null}
   654	
   655	      <StickyCartButton />
   656	
   657	      <AndroidStatusBarTint
   658	        dimmed={shouldDimAndroidStatusBar}
   659	      />
   660	      <AndroidNavigationBarTint
   661	        dimStatusBar={shouldDimAndroidStatusBar}
   662	        pathname={pathname}
   663	      />
   664	      <StartupTutorialOverlay
   665	        contentOpacity={startupTransitionProgress}
   666	        headerScrollY={headerScrollY}
   667	        onClose={handleStartupTutorialClose}
   668	        visible={shouldShowStartupTutorial}
   669	      />
   670	      <StartupIconSplash
   671	        opacity={startupSplashOpacity}
   672	        visible={!isStartupSplashDismissed}
   673	      />
   674	    </View>
   675	  );
   676	}
   677	
   678	export default function RootLayout() {
   679	  const headerScrollY = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   680	  const [minimumSplashElapsed, setMinimumSplashElapsed] = useState(false);
   681	
   682	  const [fontsLoaded] = useFonts({
   683	    "Dream Avenue": require("../assets/fonts/dream_avenue/dream_avenue.ttf"),
   684	    "Great Vibes": require("../assets/fonts/great_vibes/GreatVibes-Regular.ttf"),
   685	    "TT Fors": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_regular.ttf"),
   686	    "TT Fors Demibold": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_demibold.ttf"),
   687	    "TT Fors Black": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_black.ttf"),
   688	    "TT Fors Light": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_light.ttf"),
   689	  });
   690	
   691	  useEffect(() => {
   692	    const minimumSplashTimer = setTimeout(() => {
   693	      setMinimumSplashElapsed(true);
   694	    }, startupSplashMinimumDuration);
   695	
   696	    return () => {
   697	      clearTimeout(minimumSplashTimer);
   698	    };
   699	  }, []);

   702

   705	  }
   706	
   707	  return (
   708	    <SafeAreaProvider>
   709	      <StripeProvider
   710	        merchantIdentifier={stripeMerchantIdentifier || undefined}
   711	        publishableKey={stripePublishableKey}
   712	        setReturnUrlSchemeOnAndroid
   713	        urlScheme={stripeUrlScheme}

   723	                  />
   724	                </ShopCartProvider>
   725	              </HeaderSwipeProvider>
   726	            </BackgroundHeroStateProvider>
   727	          </HeaderScrollProvider>
   728	        </ThemeProvider>
   729	      </StripeProvider>
   730	    </SafeAreaProvider>
   731	  );
   732	}

    31	function isMatchingLayout(currentLayout, nextLayout) {
    32	  return (
    33	    currentLayout &&
    34	    Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
    35	    Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
    36	  );

   194	function ProductMagnifySection({ croppedImageWidth, onBuyPress, product, scrollY }) {
   195	  const [buyButtonLayout, setBuyButtonLayout] = useState(null);
   196	  const [imageLayout, setImageLayout] = useState(null);
   197	  const [lowerContentLayout, setLowerContentLayout] = useState(null);
   198	
   199	  const updateLayout = useCallback((setter) => ({ nativeEvent }) => {
   200	    const nextLayout = nativeEvent.layout;
   201	
   202	    setter((currentLayout) => {
   203	      if (
   204	        currentLayout &&
   205	        Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
   206	        Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
   207	      ) {
   208	        return currentLayout;
   209	      }
   210	
   211	      return nextLayout;
   212	    });
   213	  }, []);
   214	
   215	  return (
   216	    <CenterMagnifyView
   217	      magnifyEnterAnchorLayout={imageLayout}
   218	      magnifyExitAnchorLayout={buyButtonLayout || lowerContentLayout}
   219	      scrollY={scrollY}
   220	      style={productsStyles.productSectionWrap}
   221	    >
   222	      <ProductSection
   223	        croppedImageWidth={croppedImageWidth}
   224	        onBuyButtonLayout={updateLayout(setBuyButtonLayout)}
   225	        onBuyPress={onBuyPress}
   226	        onImageLayout={updateLayout(setImageLayout)}
   227	        onLowerContentLayout={updateLayout(setLowerContentLayout)}
   228	        product={product}
   229	      />
   230	    </CenterMagnifyView>
   231	  );
   232	}
   233	
   234	export default function ProductsScreen() {
   235	  const {
   236	    compactTopLayout,
   237	    initialContentOffset,
   238	    scrollContentInsetStyle,
   239	    scrollHandlers,
   240	    scrollY,
   241	  } =
   242	    useMainScreenScrollProps();
   243	  const screenSwipeHandlers = useMainScreenSwipeNavigation();
   244	  const { width: windowWidth } = useWindowDimensions();
   245	  const croppedImageWidth = getFeatureImageWidth(windowWidth);
   246	  const openProductInShop = (productTitle) => {
   247	    router.push({
   248	      pathname: "/shop",
   249	      params: {
   250	        openProduct: String(Date.now()),
   251	        product: productTitle,
   252	      },
   253	    });
   254	  };
   255	
   256	  return (
   257	    <View style={productsStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>
   258	      <Animated.ScrollView
   259	        style={productsStyles.scroll}

   261	          productsStyles.scrollContent,
   262	          scrollContentInsetStyle,
   263	        ]}
   264	        contentOffset={initialContentOffset}
   265	        decelerationRate={0.95}
   266	        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
   267	        scrollEventThrottle={16}
   268	        {...getMainScreenScrollViewProps()}
   269	        {...screenSwipeHandlers}
   270	        {...scrollHandlers}
   271	      >
   272	        <View style={productsStyles.main}>

    16	
    17	function isMatchingLayout(currentLayout, nextLayout) {
    18	  return (
    19	    currentLayout &&
    20	    Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
    21	    Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
    22	  );
    23	}
    24	
    25	export default function AboutusScreen() {
    26	  const [sectionLayouts, setSectionLayouts] = useState({});
    27	  const {
    28	    compactTopLayout,
    29	    initialContentOffset,
    30	    scrollContentInsetStyle,
    31	    scrollHandlers,
    32	    scrollY,
    33	  } =
    34	    useMainScreenScrollProps();

    36	  const { width: windowWidth } = useWindowDimensions();
    37	  const croppedImageWidth = getFeatureImageWidth(windowWidth);
    38	  const croppedImageHeight = croppedImageWidth * featureImageAspectRatio;
    39	  const handleSectionLayout = useCallback(
    40	    (sectionName) =>
    41	      ({ nativeEvent }) => {
    42	        const { height, y } = nativeEvent.layout;
    43	        const nextLayout = { height, y };
    44	
    45	        setSectionLayouts((currentLayouts) => {
    46	          if (isMatchingLayout(currentLayouts[sectionName], nextLayout)) {
    47	            return currentLayouts;
    48	          }
    49	
    50	          return {
    51	            ...currentLayouts,
    52	            [sectionName]: nextLayout,
    53	          };
    54	        });
    55	      },
    56	    []
    57	  );
    58	
    59	  return (
    60	    <View style={aboutusStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>
    61	      <Animated.ScrollView
    62	        style={aboutusStyles.scroll}
    63	        contentContainerStyle={[
    64	          aboutusStyles.scrollContent,
    65	          scrollContentInsetStyle,
    66	        ]}
    67	        contentOffset={initialContentOffset}
    68	        decelerationRate={0.95}
    69	        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}

FILE: mob/app/contact.js

     1	import { useState } from "react";
     2	import { Alert, Animated, Text, TextInput, View } from "react-native";
     3	
     4	import CenterMagnifyView from "../components/CenterMagnifyView";
     5	import HapticPressable from "../components/HapticPressable";
     6	import MainScreenIntroSpacer from "../components/MainScreenIntroSpacer";
     7	import contactStyles from "../styles/contactStyles";
     8	import { sendContactMessage } from "../utils/contactMessages";
     9	import { useMainScreenScrollProps } from "../utils/mainScreenScrollContext";
    10	import { getMainScreenScrollViewProps } from "../utils/platformLayout";
    11	import { getTextInputKeyboardProps } from "../utils/textInputKeyboardProps";
    12	import useMainScreenSwipeNavigation from "../utils/useMainScreenSwipeNavigation";
    13	
    14	export default function ContactScreen() {
    15	  const [name, setName] = useState("");
    16	  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
    17	  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
    18	  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
    19	  const [emptyTouchedFieldKeys, setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys] = useState({});
    20	  const [blurredFieldKeys, setBlurredFieldKeys] = useState({});
    21	  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);
    22	  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState("");
    23	  const {
    24	    compactTopLayout,
    25	    initialContentOffset,
    26	    scrollContentInsetStyle,
    27	    scrollHandlers,
    28	    scrollY,
    29	  } =
    30	    useMainScreenScrollProps();
    31	  const screenSwipeHandlers = useMainScreenSwipeNavigation();
    32	  const trimmedName = name.trim();
    33	  const trimmedEmail = email.trim();
    34	  const trimmedMessage = message.trim();
    35	  const isEmailValid = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(trimmedEmail);
    36	  const canSubmit =
    37	    trimmedName.length > 0 &&
    38	    isEmailValid &&
    39	    trimmedMessage.length > 0 &&
    40	    !isSending;
    41	
    42	  const contactFieldValues = {
    43	    email,
    44	    message,
    45	    name,
    46	    phone,
    47	  };
    48	  const shouldShowFieldFault = (fieldKey) =>
    49	    Boolean(emptyTouchedFieldKeys[fieldKey]) ||
    50	    (fieldKey === "email" &&
    51	      Boolean(blurredFieldKeys.email) &&
    52	      trimmedEmail.length > 0 &&
    53	      !isEmailValid);
    54	
    55	  const clearFieldFault = (fieldKey) => {
    56	    setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    57	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    58	        return currentFieldKeys;
    59	      }
    60	
    61	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    62	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    63	      return nextFieldKeys;
    64	    });
    65	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    66	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    67	        return currentFieldKeys;
    68	      }
    69	
    70	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    71	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    72	      return nextFieldKeys;
    73	    });
    74	  };
    75	
    76	  const markFieldBlurred = (fieldKey) => {
    77	    const fieldValue = contactFieldValues[fieldKey] || "";
    78	
    79	    setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
    80	      ...currentFieldKeys,
    81	      [fieldKey]: true,
    82	    }));
    83	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    84	      const isFieldEmpty = fieldValue.trim().length === 0;
    85	
    86	      if (isFieldEmpty) {
    87	        return {
    88	          ...currentFieldKeys,
    89	          [fieldKey]: true,
    90	        };
    91	      }
    92	
    93	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    94	        return currentFieldKeys;
    95	      }
    96	
    97	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    98	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    99	      return nextFieldKeys;
   100	    });
   101	  };
   102	
   103	  const updateContactField = (fieldKey, text, setter) => {
   104	    setter(text);
   105	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
   106	      if (text.trim().length === 0 || !currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
   107	        return currentFieldKeys;
   108	      }
   109	
   110	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
   111	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
   112	      return nextFieldKeys;
   113	    });
   114	  };
   115	
   116	  const showContactAlert = (title, alertMessage) => {
   117	    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof window.alert === "function") {
   118	      window.alert(`${title}\n${alertMessage}`);
   119	      return;
   120	    }
   121	
   122	    Alert.alert(title, alertMessage);
   123	  };
   124	
   125	  const handleSubmit = async () => {
   126	    if (!canSubmit) {
   127	      setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
   128	        ...currentFieldKeys,
   129	        email: true,
   130	      }));
   131	      setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
   132	        ...currentFieldKeys,
   133	        ...(trimmedName.length === 0 ? { name: true } : {}),
   134	        ...(trimmedEmail.length === 0 ? { email: true } : {}),
   135	        ...(trimmedMessage.length === 0 ? { message: true } : {}),
   136	      }));
   137	      setStatusMessage("Please enter your name, email, and message.");
   138	      return;
   139	    }
   140	
   141	    setIsSending(true);
   142	    setStatusMessage("");
   143	
   144	    try {
   145	      await sendContactMessage({
   146	        email: trimmedEmail,
   147	        message: trimmedMessage,
   148	        name: trimmedName,
   149	        phone: phone.trim(),
   150	      });
   151	      setName("");
   152	      setEmail("");
   153	      setPhone("");
   154	      setMessage("");
   155	      setBlurredFieldKeys({});
   156	      setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys({});
   157	      setStatusMessage("Message sent. We will respond within 48 hours.");
   158	      showContactAlert(
   159	        "Message sent",
   160	        "Thank you. Your message was sent to Alla Vostra.",
   161	      );
   162	    } catch (error) {
   163	      const errorMessage = error?.message || "Please try again.";
   164	      setStatusMessage(errorMessage);
   165	      showContactAlert("Message not sent", errorMessage);
   166	    } finally {
   167	      setIsSending(false);
   168	    }
   169	  };
   170	
   171	  return (
   172	    <View style={contactStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>
   173	      <Animated.ScrollView
   174	        style={contactStyles.scroll}
   175	        contentContainerStyle={[
   176	          contactStyles.scrollContent,
   177	          scrollContentInsetStyle,
   178	        ]}
   179	        contentOffset={initialContentOffset}
   180	        decelerationRate={0.95}
   181	        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
   182	        scrollEventThrottle={16}
   183	        {...getMainScreenScrollViewProps()}
   184	        {...screenSwipeHandlers}
   185	        {...scrollHandlers}
   186	      >
   187	        <View style={contactStyles.main}>
   188	          <MainScreenIntroSpacer
   189	            compactTopLayout={compactTopLayout}
   190	            pageTitleStyle={contactStyles.pageTitle}
   191	            scrollY={scrollY}
   192	          />
   193	
   194	          <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   195	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>Got a business inquiry?</Text>
   196	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>
   197	              General questions about our products?
   198	            </Text>
   199	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>
   200	              We strive to respond within 48 hours.
   201	            </Text>
   202	          </CenterMagnifyView>
   203	
   204	          <View style={contactStyles.formCard}>
   205	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   206	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Full Name</Text>
   207	              <TextInput
   208	                style={[
   209	                  contactStyles.input,
   210	                  shouldShowFieldFault("name") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   211	                ]}
   212	                placeholder="Your Name"
   213	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   214	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("name")}
   215	                onChangeText={(text) => updateContactField("name", text, setName)}
   216	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("name")}
   217	                returnKeyType="next"
   218	                textContentType="name"
   219	                value={name}
   220	              />
   221	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   222	
   223	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   224	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Email Address</Text>
   225	              <TextInput
   226	                style={[
   227	                  contactStyles.input,
   228	                  shouldShowFieldFault("email") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   229	                ]}
   230	                placeholder="you@company.com"
   231	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   232	                keyboardType="email-address"
   233	                autoCapitalize="none"
   234	                autoCorrect={false}
   235	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("email")}
   236	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   237	                  updateContactField("email", text, setEmail)
   238	                }
   239	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("email")}
   240	                returnKeyType="next"
   241	                textContentType="emailAddress"
   242	                value={email}
   243	              />
   244	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   245	
   246	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   247	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Phone Number</Text>
   248	              <TextInput
   249	                {...getTextInputKeyboardProps({
   250	                  fieldKey: "phone",
   251	                  keyboardType: "phone-pad",
   252	                })}
   253	                style={[
   254	                  contactStyles.input,
   255	                  shouldShowFieldFault("phone") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   256	                ]}
   257	                placeholder="+1 (555) 1234-567"
   258	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   259	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("phone")}
   260	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   261	                  updateContactField("phone", text, setPhone)
   262	                }
   263	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("phone")}
   264	                returnKeyType="next"
   265	                value={phone}
   266	              />
   267	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   268	
   269	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   270	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Your Message</Text>
   271	              <TextInput
   272	                style={[
   273	                  contactStyles.input,
   274	                  contactStyles.messageInput,
   275	                  shouldShowFieldFault("message") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   276	                ]}
   277	                placeholder="Your Message"
   278	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   279	                multiline
   280	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("message")}
   281	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   282	                  updateContactField("message", text, setMessage)
   283	                }
   284	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("message")}
   285	                returnKeyType="default"
   286	                textAlignVertical="top"
   287	                value={message}
   288	              />
   289	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   290	
   291	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY} style={contactStyles.buttonWrap}>

   300	              >

   107	function getProductServingCount(description) {
   108	  const match = description.match(productServingLeadPattern);
   109	
   110	  if (!match) {
   111	    return "";
   112	  }
   113	
   114	  return match[2];
   115	}

   117	function getRequestedOverlayProductName(value) {
   118	  const rawValue = Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value;
   119	  const requestedName = String(rawValue || "").trim();
   120	
   121	  if (!requestedName) {
   122	    return "";
   123	  }
   124	
   125	  const normalizedRequestedName = requestedName.toLowerCase();
   126	  const requestedProduct = products.find(
   127	    (product) => product.name.toLowerCase() === normalizedRequestedName,
   128	  );
   129	
   130	  return requestedProduct?.name || "";
   131	}

   329	const getOverlayRequiredFieldKeys = (rows) =>
   330	  rows.reduce((fieldKeys, row) => {
   331	    row.forEach((field) => {
   332	      if (
   333	        field.type === "rowGapAfter" ||
   334	        field.type === "sectionHeading" ||
   335	        field.type === "spacer"
   336	      ) {
   337	        return;
   338	      }
   339	
   340	      if (field.type === "contactInfoBlock" || field.type === "fieldGroup") {
   341	        field.fields.forEach((groupField) => {
   342	          if (groupField.type === "spacer") {
   343	            return;
   344	          }
   345	
   346	          fieldKeys.push(groupField.key);
   347	        });
   348	        return;
   349	      }
   350	
   351	      if (field.type === "deliveryTimeWheels") {
   352	        fieldKeys.push(...deliveryTimeRequiredFieldKeys);
   353	        return;
   354	      }
   355	
   356	      fieldKeys.push(field.key);
   357	    });
   358	
   359	    return fieldKeys;
   360	  }, []);

   632	  );

   653	const getOrdinalDateLabel = (dateNumber) => {
   654	  const lastTwoDigits = dateNumber % 100;
   655	
   656	  if (lastTwoDigits >= 11 && lastTwoDigits <= 13) {
   657	    return `${dateNumber}th`;
   658	  }
   659	
   660	  switch (dateNumber % 10) {
   661	    case 1:
   662	      return `${dateNumber}st`;
   663	    case 2:
   664	      return `${dateNumber}nd`;
   665	    case 3:
   666	      return `${dateNumber}rd`;
   667	    default:
   668	      return `${dateNumber}th`;
   669	  }
   670	};

   776	function getStripeCardBrandLabel(brand) {
   777	  switch (brand) {
   778	    case "Visa":
   779	      return "VISA";
   780	    case "MasterCard":
   781	      return "MASTERCARD";
   782	    case "AmericanExpress":
   783	      return "AMEX";
   784	    case "Unknown":
   785	    case undefined:
   786	    case null:
   787	      return "";
   788	    default:
   789	      return String(brand)
   790	        .replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2")
   791	        .toUpperCase();
   792	  }
   793	}
   794	
   795	const normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits = (text, maxLength) =>
   796	  String(text || "")
   797	    .replace(/\D/g, "")
   798	    .slice(0, maxLength);
   799	
   800	function formatPaymentCardFallbackValue(fieldKey, text) {
   801	  if (fieldKey === "number") {
   802	    return normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(text, 19)
   803	      .replace(/(.{4})/g, "$1 ")
   804	      .trim();
   805	  }
   806	
   807	  if (fieldKey === "expiration") {
   808	    const digits = normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(text, 4);
   809	
   810	    return digits.length > 2
   811	      ? `${digits.slice(0, 2)}/${digits.slice(2)}`
   812	      : digits;
   813	  }
   814	
   815	  if (fieldKey === "cvc") {
   816	    return normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(text, 4);
   817	  }
   818	
   819	  if (fieldKey === "postalCode") {
   820	    return normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(text, 5);
   821	  }
   822	
   823	  return text;
   824	}
   825	
   826	function getPaymentCardFallbackStripeBrand(number) {
   827	  const digits = normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(number, 19);
   828	  const firstTwoDigits = Number(digits.slice(0, 2));
   829	  const firstFourDigits = Number(digits.slice(0, 4));
   830	
   831	  if (digits.startsWith("4")) {
   832	    return "Visa";
   833	  }
   834	
   835	  if (digits.startsWith("34") || digits.startsWith("37")) {
   836	    return "AmericanExpress";
   837	  }
   838	
   839	  if (
   840	    (firstTwoDigits >= 51 && firstTwoDigits <= 55) ||
   841	    (firstFourDigits >= 2221 && firstFourDigits <= 2720)
   842	  ) {
   843	    return "MasterCard";
   844	  }
   845	
   846	  return "Unknown";
   847	}

   849	function getNormalizedPaymentCardFallbackValues(values) {
   850	  return {
   851	    cvc: normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(values.cvc, 4),
   852	    expiration: normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(values.expiration, 4),
   853	    number: normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(values.number, 19),
   854	    postalCode: normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(values.postalCode, 5),
   855	  };
   856	}
   857	
   858	function isPaymentCardFallbackComplete(values) {
   859	  const normalizedValues = getNormalizedPaymentCardFallbackValues(values);
   860	  const expirationMonth = Number(normalizedValues.expiration.slice(0, 2));
   861	
   862	  return (
   863	    normalizedValues.number.length >= 12 &&
   864	    normalizedValues.expiration.length === 4 &&
   865	    expirationMonth >= 1 &&
   866	    expirationMonth <= 12 &&
   867	    normalizedValues.cvc.length >= 3 &&
   868	    normalizedValues.postalCode.length >= 5
   869	  );
   870	}

  1100	function PiccolaQuantityTriangle({ direction, muted }) {

  1130	          "Z",

  2336	  const releaseDeliveryTimeWheelSwipe = (fieldKey, options, pageY) => {
  2337	    const startY = deliveryTimeWheelTouchStartYRef.current[fieldKey];
  2338	    const endY = Number.isFinite(pageY)
  2339	      ? pageY
  2340	      : deliveryTimeWheelTouchCurrentYRef.current[fieldKey];
  2341	    delete deliveryTimeWheelTouchStartYRef.current[fieldKey];
  2342	    delete deliveryTimeWheelTouchCurrentYRef.current[fieldKey];
  2343	
  2344	    if (!Number.isFinite(startY) || !Number.isFinite(endY)) {
  2345	      return;
  2346	    }
  2347	
  2348	    const deltaY = endY - startY;
  2349	
  2350	    if (Math.abs(deltaY) < deliveryTimeWheelSwipeThreshold) {
  2351	      return;
  2352	    }
  2353	
  2354	    const stepCount = Math.max(
  2355	      1,
  2356	      Math.min(3, Math.round(Math.abs(deltaY) / 28)),
  2357	    );
  2358	    stepDeliveryTimeWheelValue(
  2359	      fieldKey,
  2360	      options,
  2361	      deltaY < 0 ? stepCount : -stepCount,

  4479	      selectedPaymentOverlayMethod !== paymentOverlayApplePayMethod &&
  4480	      selectedPaymentOverlayMethod !== paymentOverlayPayPalMethod

  4537	    } else if (selectedPaymentOverlayMethod === paymentOverlayGooglePayMethod) {
  4538	      if (Platform.OS !== "android") {

    94	function getActivePageFromPath(pathname) {
    95	  if (pathname === "/products") return "products";
    96	  if (pathname === "/aboutus") return "aboutus";
    97	  if (pathname === "/contact") return "contact";

   102	function getNavigationDirection(fromPage, toPage) {
   103	  const fromIndex = navPages.indexOf(fromPage);
   104	  const toIndex = navPages.indexOf(toPage);
   105	
   106	  if (fromIndex < 0 || toIndex < 0 || fromIndex === toIndex) return 1;
   107	
   108	  const lastPageIndex = navPages.length - 1;
   109	
   110	  if (fromIndex === lastPageIndex && toIndex === 0) return 1;
   111	  if (fromIndex === 0 && toIndex === lastPageIndex) return -1;
   112	
   113	  return toIndex > fromIndex ? 1 : -1;
   114	}

   231	    fallbackHeldArrowOpacity.setValue(arrowHintPeakOpacity);
   232	  };
   233	
   234	  const hideHeldArrows = () => {
   235	    if (screenSwipe?.hideHeldArrowHint) {
   236	      screenSwipe.hideHeldArrowHint();
   237	      return;
   238	    }
   239	
   240	    fallbackHeldArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   241	    fallbackHeldArrowOpacity.setValue(0);
   242	  };
   243	
   244	  const cancelHeldArrows = () => {
   245	    if (screenSwipe?.cancelHeldArrowHint) {
   246	      screenSwipe.cancelHeldArrowHint();
   247	      return;
   248	    }
   249	
   250	    hideHeldArrows();
   251	  };
   252	
   253	  const updateHeldArrowsFromTouchMove = (event) => {
   254	    screenSwipe?.updateHeldArrowHintMovement?.(event);
   255	    return false;
   256	  };
   257	
   258	  const clearDirectionalArrowLinger = () => {
   259	    if (screenSwipe?.clearDirectionalArrowLinger) {
   260	      screenSwipe.clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   261	      return;
   262	    }
   263	
   264	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   265	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   266	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression.stopAnimation();
   267	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity.setValue(0);
   268	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity.setValue(0);
   269	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression.setValue(0);
   270	  };
   271	
   272	  const startDirectionalArrowLinger = (direction) => {
   273	    if (screenSwipe?.startDirectionalArrowLinger) {
   274	      screenSwipe.startDirectionalArrowLinger(direction);
   275	      return;
   276	    }
   277	
   278	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   279	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   280	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression.stopAnimation();
   281	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression.setValue(1);
   282	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity.setValue(
   283	      direction === "left" ? arrowHintPeakOpacity : 0
   284	    );
   285	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity.setValue(
   286	      direction === "right" ? arrowHintPeakOpacity : 0
   287	    );
   288	  };
   289	
   290	  const updateSwipePreview = (dragDistance) => {
   291	    if (!screenSwipe) return;
   292	
   293	    screenSwipe.updateSwipe({
   294	      x: dragDistance,
   295	    });
   296	  };
   297	
   298	  const animateIndicatorBetweenIndexes = (fromIndex, toIndex) => {
   299	    if (fromIndex === toIndex) {
   300	      if (!indicatorAnimationRef.current) {
   301	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   302	      }
   303	      return;
   304	    }
   305	
   306	    if (indicatorAnimationRef.current) {
   307	      const previousAnimation = indicatorAnimationRef.current;
   308	      indicatorAnimationRef.current = null;
   309	      previousAnimation.stop();
   310	    }
   311	
   312	    indicatorIndexRef.current = toIndex;
   313	
   314	    const createIndicatorTiming = (toValue, duration = indicatorSlideDuration) =>
   315	      Animated.timing(indicatorProgress, {
   316	        toValue,
   317	        duration,
   318	        useNativeDriver: true,
   319	      });
   320	
   321	    const lastPageIndex = navPages.length - 1;
   322	    const animation =
   323	      fromIndex === lastPageIndex && toIndex === 0
   324	        ? Animated.sequence([
   325	            createIndicatorTiming(navPages.length),
   326	            createIndicatorTiming(-1, 0),
   327	            createIndicatorTiming(toIndex),
   328	          ])
   329	        : fromIndex === 0 && toIndex === lastPageIndex
   330	        ? Animated.sequence([
   331	            createIndicatorTiming(-1),
   332	            createIndicatorTiming(navPages.length, 0),
   333	            createIndicatorTiming(toIndex),
   334	          ])
   335	        : createIndicatorTiming(toIndex);
   336	
   337	    indicatorAnimationRef.current = animation;
   338	
   339	    animation.start(({ finished }) => {
   340	      if (finished) {
   341	        indicatorIndexRef.current = toIndex;
   342	      }
   343	
   344	      if (indicatorAnimationRef.current === animation) {
   345	        indicatorAnimationRef.current = null;
   346	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   347	      }
   348	    });
   349	  };
   350	
   351	  useEffect(() => {
   352	    animateIndicatorBetweenIndexes(indicatorIndexRef.current, activePageIndex);
   353	  }, [activePageIndex, indicatorProgress]);
   354	
   355	  const animateIndicatorToPage = (pageName) => {
   356	    const pageIndex = navPages.indexOf(pageName);
   357	    if (pageIndex < 0) return;
   358	
   359	    animateIndicatorBetweenIndexes(activeIndexRef.current, pageIndex);
   360	  };
   361	
   362	  const goToPage = (pageName, animateIndicator = true) => {
   363	    hideHeldArrows();
   364	
   365	    if (pageName === activePageRef.current) {
   366	      if (pageName === "shop") {
   367	        goToPage("home", animateIndicator);
   368	      }
   369	
   370	      return;
   371	    }
   372	
   373	    const route = pageRoutes[pageName];
   374	    if (!route) return;
   375	
   376	    if (navPages.includes(pageName)) {
   377	      if (!canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current?.()) {
   378	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   379	        screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   380	        return;
   381	      }
   382	
   383	      backgroundHeroState?.freezeHero(safeScrollY);
   384	      if (animateIndicator) animateIndicatorToPage(pageName);
   385	      router.replace(route);
   386	      return;
   387	    }
   388	
   389	    router.push(route);
   390	  };
   391	
   392	  const goToPreviousPage = () => {
   393	    if (Date.now() < suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current) return;
   394	
   395	    const previousIndex =
   396	      (activeIndexRef.current + navPages.length - 1) % navPages.length;
   397	
   398	    goToPage(navPages[previousIndex], true, -1);
   399	  };
   400	
   401	  const goToNextPage = () => {
   402	    if (Date.now() < suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current) return;
   403	
   404	    const nextIndex = (activeIndexRef.current + 1) % navPages.length;
   405	
   406	    goToPage(navPages[nextIndex], true, 1);
   407	  };
   408	
   409	  const shouldClaimCarouselSwipe = (_, gestureState) => {
   410	    if (!canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current?.()) return false;
   411	
   412	    const horizontalDistance = Math.abs(gestureState.dx);
   413	    const verticalDistance = Math.abs(gestureState.dy);
   414	
   415	    if (
   416	      horizontalDistance >= tapHoldHorizontalCancelDistance &&
   417	      horizontalDistance > verticalDistance * tapHoldHorizontalDominanceRatio
   418	    ) {
   419	      cancelHeldArrows();
   420	    }
   421	
   422	    const shouldClaim =
   423	      horizontalDistance > carouselSwipeActivationDistance &&
   424	      horizontalDistance > verticalDistance * carouselSwipeActivationRatio;
   425	
   426	    if (shouldClaim) {
   427	      cancelHeldArrows();
   428	    }
   429	
   430	    return shouldClaim;
   431	  };
   432	
   433	  const carouselPanResponder = useRef(
   434	    PanResponder.create({
   435	      onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: shouldClaimCarouselSwipe,
   436	
   437	      onMoveShouldSetPanResponderCapture: shouldClaimCarouselSwipe,
   438	
   439	      onPanResponderTerminationRequest: (_, gestureState) =>
   440	        !shouldClaimCarouselSwipe(null, gestureState),
   441	
   442	      onPanResponderMove: (_, gestureState) => {
   443	        if (!canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current?.()) return;
   444	
   445	        suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current = Date.now() + 500;
   446	        updateSwipePreview(gestureState.dx);
   447	
   448	        if (gestureState.dx <= -carouselSwipeCommitDistance) {
   449	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("left");
   450	          return;
   451	        }
   452	
   453	        if (gestureState.dx >= carouselSwipeCommitDistance) {
   454	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("right");
   455	          return;
   456	        }
   457	
   458	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   459	      },
   460	
   461	      onPanResponderRelease: (_, gestureState) => {
   462	        suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current = Date.now() + 500;
   463	        hideHeldArrows();
   464	
   465	        if (!canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current?.()) {
   466	          clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   467	          screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   468	          return;
   469	        }
   470	
   471	        if (gestureState.dx <= -carouselSwipeCommitDistance) {
   472	          const nextIndex = (activeIndexRef.current + 1) % navPages.length;
   473	          const nextPage = navPages[nextIndex];
   474	
   475	          updateSwipePreview(gestureState.dx);
   476	          screenSwipe?.commitSwipe({
   477	            x: gestureState.dx,
   478	            page: nextPage,
   479	            direction: 1,
   480	            fromPage: activePageRef.current,
   481	          });
   482	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("left");
   483	          goToPage(nextPage, true, 1);
   484	
   485	          return;
   486	        }
   487	
   488	        if (gestureState.dx >= carouselSwipeCommitDistance) {
   489	          const previousIndex =
   490	            (activeIndexRef.current + navPages.length - 1) % navPages.length;
   491	          const previousPage = navPages[previousIndex];
   492	
   493	          updateSwipePreview(gestureState.dx);
   494	          screenSwipe?.commitSwipe({
   495	            x: gestureState.dx,
   496	            page: previousPage,
   497	            direction: -1,
   498	            fromPage: activePageRef.current,
   499	          });
   500	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("right");
   501	          goToPage(previousPage, true, -1);
   502	
   503	          return;
   504	        }
   505	
   506	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   507	        screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   508	      },
   509	
   510	      onPanResponderTerminate: () => {
   511	        suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current = Date.now() + 500;
   512	        hideHeldArrows();
   513	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   514	        screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   515	      },
   516	
   517	      onShouldBlockNativeResponder: () => true,
   518	    })
   519	  ).current;
   520	
   521	  useEffect(() => {
   522	    hideHeldArrows();
   523	
   524	    return () => {
   525	      hideHeldArrows();
   526	    };
   527	  }, [resolvedActivePage, showCarousel, showOnlyHero]);
   528	
   529	  useEffect(
   530	    () => () => {
   531	      clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   532	    },
   533	    []
   534	  );
   535	
   536	  const activeLink = pageLabels[resolvedActivePage] || "Home";
   537	  const arrowLinkTranslateX = 0;
   538	
   539	  const scrollBeganArrowVisibility = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   540	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   541	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   542	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   543	  });
   544	  const oldHeaderArrowVisibility = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   545	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   546	    outputRange: [1, 0],
   547	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   548	  });
   549	  const oldHeaderHeldArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   550	    heldArrowOpacity.interpolate({
   551	      inputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   552	      outputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   553	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   554	    }),
   555	    oldHeaderArrowVisibility
   556	  );
   557	  const scrolledStateArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   558	    scrollBeganArrowVisibility,
   559	    arrowHintPeakOpacity
   560	  );
   561	  const scrolledVisibleArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   562	    heldArrowOpacity,
   563	    scrolledStateArrowOpacity
   564	  );
   565	  const gatedScrolledArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   566	    scrolledVisibleArrowOpacity.interpolate({
   567	      inputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   568	      outputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   569	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   570	    }),
   571	    scrollBeganArrowVisibility
   572	  );
   573	  const gatedVisibleArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   574	    oldHeaderHeldArrowOpacity,
   575	    gatedScrolledArrowOpacity
   576	  ).interpolate({
   577	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   578	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   579	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   580	  });
   581	  const directionalBaseArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   582	    gatedVisibleArrowOpacity,
   583	    directionalArrowBaseSuppression.interpolate({
   584	      inputRange: [0, 1],
   585	      outputRange: [1, 0],
   586	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   587	    })
   588	  );
   589	  const leftArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   590	    directionalBaseArrowOpacity,
   591	    directionalLeftArrowOpacity
   592	  ).interpolate({
   593	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   594	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   595	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   596	  });
   597	  const rightArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   598	    directionalBaseArrowOpacity,
   599	    directionalRightArrowOpacity
   600	  ).interpolate({
   601	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   602	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   603	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   604	  });
   605	
   606	  const heroVerticalFadeTranslateY = resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   607	    inputRange: [0, heroVerticalFadeScrollDistance],
   608	    outputRange: [heroVerticalFadeHeight, -heroVerticalFadeFeatherHeight],
   609	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   610	  });
   611	
   612	  const stickyOffset =
   613	    Platform.OS === "web"
   614	      ? 0
   615	      : resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   616	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   617	          outputRange: [0, carouselStickyOffsetY],
   618	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   619	        });
   620	  const carouselExpansionOffsetY =
   621	    Platform.OS === "ios"
   622	      ? resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   623	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   624	          outputRange: [0, carouselExpansionHeight],
   625	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   626	        })
   627	      : stickyOffset;
   628	  const carouselInnerTranslateY = carouselExpansionOffsetY;
   629	  const centerShadowOpacity =
   630	    Platform.OS === "web"
   631	      ? 1
   632	      : resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   633	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   634	          outputRange: [0, 1],
   635	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   636	        });
   637	
   638	  const stickyExpansionTranslateY = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   639	    inputRange: [96, 120],
   640	    outputRange: [-stickyExpansionMaxHeight, 0],
   641	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   642	  });
   643	
   644	  const heroScale = resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   645	    inputRange: [0, heroFadeScrollDistance],
   646	    outputRange: [heroStartScale, heroScaleAtMinimumOpacity],
   647	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   648	  });
   649	
   650	  const heroTranslateY = resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   651	    inputRange: [0, heroFadeScrollDistance],
   652	    outputRange: [heroStartTranslateY, heroTranslateYAtMinimumOpacity],
   653	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   654	  });
   655	
   656	  const headerTranslateY = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   657	    inputRange: [0, 120],
   658	    outputRange: [0, -120],
   659	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   660	  });
   661	
   662	  const indicatorSegmentWidth = windowWidth / navPages.length;
   663	  const indicatorTranslateX = Animated.multiply(
   664	    indicatorProgress,
   665	    indicatorSegmentWidth
   666	  );
   667	  const isMainHeroPage = navPages.includes(resolvedActivePage);
   668	  const heroImageSource = isMainHeroPage
   669	    ? noCheeseboardHeroImage
   670	    : defaultHeroImage;
   671	  const mainHeroVisualOpacity = isMainHeroPage
   672	    ? resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   673	        inputRange: [0, heroFadeScrollDistance],
   674	        outputRange: [1, heroMinimumScrollOpacity],
   675	        extrapolate: "clamp",
   676	      })
   677	    : 1;
   678	  const heroWidthFitScale = windowWidth / heroSourceWidth;
   679	  const heroWidthFitImageHeight = heroSourceHeight * heroWidthFitScale;
   680	  const heroImageFrameStyle = isMainHeroPage
   681	    ? {
   682	        width: windowWidth,
   683	        height: heroWidthFitImageHeight,
   684	      }
   685	    : null;
   686	  const heroImageTransformStyle = isMainHeroPage
   687	    ? null
   688	    : {
   689	        transform: [{ scale: heroScale }, { translateY: heroTranslateY }],
   690	      };
   691	  const heroImageOpacityStyle = isMainHeroPage
   692	    ? { opacity: mainHeroVisualOpacity }
   693	    : null;
   694	  const heroCoverScale = Math.max(
   695	    windowWidth / heroSourceWidth,
   696	    heroVerticalFadeHeight / heroSourceHeight
   697	  );
   698	  const heroLayoutScale = isMainHeroPage ? heroWidthFitScale : heroCoverScale;
   699	  const heroRenderedWidth = heroSourceWidth * heroLayoutScale;
   700	  const heroRenderedHeight = heroSourceHeight * heroLayoutScale;
   701	  const heroRenderedLeft = (windowWidth - heroRenderedWidth) / 2;
   702	  const heroRenderedTop = isMainHeroPage
   703	    ? 0
   704	    : (heroVerticalFadeHeight - heroRenderedHeight) / 2;
   705	  const noCheeseboardVisibleBottomY = Math.min(
   706	    heroVerticalFadeHeight,
   707	    heroRenderedTop + noCheeseboardVisibleBottomSourceY * heroLayoutScale
   708	  );
   709	  const cheeseboardWidth = cheeseboardSourceWidth * heroLayoutScale;
   710	  const cheeseboardHeight = cheeseboardSourceHeight * heroLayoutScale;
   711	  const cheeseboardLeft =
   712	    heroRenderedLeft + cheeseboardSourceX * heroLayoutScale;
   713	  const cheeseboardTop = isMainHeroPage
   714	    ? noCheeseboardVisibleBottomY - cheeseboardHeight / 2
   715	    : heroRenderedTop + cheeseboardSourceY * heroLayoutScale;
   716	  const routeTransitionState = screenSwipe?.routeTransitionState;
   717	  const isCheeseboardNavigationMotionDisabled =
   718	    isMainHeroPage && isHeaderNewState(resolvedHeroMotionScrollY);
   719	  const isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive =
   720	    isMainHeroPage &&
   721	    !isCheeseboardNavigationMotionDisabled &&
   722	    Boolean(routeTransitionState?.isActive);
   723	  const isCheeseboardSwipeActive =
   724	    isMainHeroPage &&
   725	    !isCheeseboardNavigationMotionDisabled &&
   726	    Boolean(screenSwipe?.isActive);
   727	  const cheeseboardTransitionDirection =
   728	    routeTransitionState?.direction === -1 ? -1 : 1;
   729	  const cheeseboardTransitionStartX =
   730	    typeof routeTransitionState?.startX === "number"
   731	      ? routeTransitionState.startX
   732	      : 0;
   733	  const cheeseboardCenteredMotionTranslateX =
   734	    Platform.OS === "ios" ? 0.01 : 0;
   735	  const cheeseboardTransitionStartTranslateX =
   736	    Math.abs(cheeseboardTransitionStartX) > 0.01
   737	      ? cheeseboardTransitionStartX
   738	      : cheeseboardCenteredMotionTranslateX;
   739	  const cheeseboardHiddenHandoffOpacity =
   740	    Platform.OS === "ios" ? 0.001 : 0;
   741	  const cheeseboardDragTranslateX = isCheeseboardSwipeActive
   742	    ? screenSwipe?.swipeX || 0
   743	    : 0;
   744	  const cheeseboardBaseTranslateX = isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive
   745	    ? 0
   746	    : cheeseboardDragTranslateX;
   747	  const cheeseboardBaseOpacity = isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive
   748	    ? routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   749	        inputRange: [0, 0.92, 1],
   750	        outputRange: [
   751	          cheeseboardHiddenHandoffOpacity,
   752	          cheeseboardHiddenHandoffOpacity,
   753	          1,
   754	        ],
   755	        extrapolate: "clamp",
   756	      })
   757	    : 1;
   758	  const cheeseboardOutgoingTranslateX = isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive
   759	    ? routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   760	        inputRange: [0, 1],
   761	        outputRange: [
   762	          cheeseboardTransitionStartTranslateX,
   763	          -cheeseboardTransitionDirection * windowWidth,
   764	        ],
   765	        extrapolate: "clamp",
   766	      })
   767	    : cheeseboardDragTranslateX;
   768	  const cheeseboardIncomingTranslateX = routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   769	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   770	    outputRange: [
   771	      cheeseboardTransitionStartTranslateX +
   772	        cheeseboardTransitionDirection * windowWidth,
   773	      cheeseboardCenteredMotionTranslateX,
   774	    ],
   775	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   776	  });
   777	  const cheeseboardIncomingOpacity = routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   778	    inputRange: [0, 0.92, 1],
   779	    outputRange: [1, 1, 0],
   780	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   781	  });
   782	  const cheeseboardPreviousPreviewTranslateX = screenSwipe?.swipeX
   783	    ? Animated.add(screenSwipe.swipeX, -windowWidth)
   784	    : -windowWidth;
   785	  const cheeseboardNextPreviewTranslateX = screenSwipe?.swipeX
   786	    ? Animated.add(screenSwipe.swipeX, windowWidth)
   787	    : windowWidth;
   788	  const shouldShowCheeseboardDragPreviews =
   789	    isMainHeroPage &&
   790	    isCheeseboardSwipeActive &&
   791	    !isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive;
   792	  const handleCarouselTouchStart = (event) => {
   793	    showHeldArrows(event);
   794	    return false;
   795	  };
   796	
   797	  const sharedHeaderTouchHandlers = {
   798	    onStartShouldSetResponderCapture: handleCarouselTouchStart,
   799	    onTouchStart: showHeldArrows,
   800	    onTouchMove: updateHeldArrowsFromTouchMove,
   801	    onTouchEnd: hideHeldArrows,
   802	    onTouchCancel: hideHeldArrows,
   803	  };
   804	
   805	  const renderArrowChevron = (direction) => (
   806	    <View
   807	      style={[
   808	        styles.arrowChevron,
   809	        direction === "left"
   810	          ? styles.arrowChevronLeft
   811	          : styles.arrowChevronRight,
   812	      ]}
   813	    />
   814	  );
   815	
   816	  const renderCheeseboardLayer = (key, translateX, opacity = 1) => {
   817	    const slideTransformStyle =
   818	      translateX === 0 ? null : { transform: [{ translateX }] };
   819	    const resolvedSlideOpacity =
   820	      isMainHeroPage && opacity !== 1
   821	        ? Animated.multiply(opacity, mainHeroVisualOpacity)
   822	        : isMainHeroPage
   823	        ? mainHeroVisualOpacity
   824	        : opacity;
   825	    const slideOpacityStyle =
   826	      resolvedSlideOpacity === 1 ? null : { opacity: resolvedSlideOpacity };
   827	
   828	    return (
   829	      <Animated.View
   830	        key={key}
   831	        collapsable={false}
   832	        pointerEvents="none"
   833	        renderToHardwareTextureAndroid
   834	        style={[
   835	          styles.cheeseboardSlideLayer,
   836	          slideTransformStyle,
   837	          slideOpacityStyle,
   838	        ]}
   839	      >
   840	        <Animated.View
   841	          collapsable={false}
   842	          style={styles.cheeseboardHeroTransformLayer}

FILE: mob/components/PageDivider.js
============================================================

     1	import { Animated } from "react-native";
     2	
     3	import sharedStyles from "../styles/sharedStyles";
     4	
     5	const topDividerFadeScrollDistance = 240;
     6	
     7	export default function PageDivider({
     8	  expandedSpacing = false,
     9	  fadeScrollDistance = topDividerFadeScrollDistance,
    10	  fadeWithScrollY = null,
    11	}) {
    12	  const fadeOpacity = fadeWithScrollY?.interpolate({
    13	    inputRange: [0, fadeScrollDistance],
    14	    outputRange: [1, 0],
    15	    extrapolate: "clamp",
    16	  });
    17	
    18	  return (
    19	    <Animated.View
    20	      style={[
    21	        sharedStyles.pageDivider,
    22	        expandedSpacing && sharedStyles.expandedPageDivider,
    23	        fadeOpacity && { opacity: fadeOpacity },
    24	      ]}
    25	    />
    26	  );
    27	}

FILE: mob/utils/headerScrollContext.js
============================================================

     1	import { createContext, useContext } from "react";
     2	
     3	const HeaderScrollContext = createContext(null);
     4	
     5	export function HeaderScrollProvider({ children, scrollY }) {
     6	  return (
     7	    <HeaderScrollContext.Provider value={scrollY}>
     8	      {children}
     9	    </HeaderScrollContext.Provider>
    10	  );
    11	}
    12	
    13	export function useHeaderScrollY() {
    14	  return useContext(HeaderScrollContext);
    15	}

============================================================
FILE: mob/utils/openPaymentLink.js
============================================================

     1	import { Alert, Linking, Platform } from "react-native";
     2	
     3	export async function openPaymentLink(url) {
     4	  if (!url) {
     5	    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
     6	      window.alert("No payment link has been added for this product yet.");
     7	      return;
     8	    }
     9	
    10	    Alert.alert("Payment link missing", "No payment link has been added yet.");
    11	    return;
    12	  }
    13	
    14	  try {
    15	    const canOpen = await Linking.canOpenURL(url);
    16	
    17	    if (!canOpen) {
    18	      throw new Error("Cannot open URL");
    19	    }
    20	
    21	    await Linking.openURL(url);
    22	  } catch (error) {
    23	    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
    24	      window.alert("Unable to open this payment link.");
    25	      return;
    26	    }
    27	
    28	    Alert.alert("Unable to open link", "Please try again later.");
    29	  }
    30	}
